about: Known gaps: brochure cost terms the app's estimate does not include (affects_cost true), and brochure contradictions (kind 'conflict': affects_cost false keeps one about a figure the estimate does not use as data only; affects_cost true marks the total estimated and shows the text, which then says the brochure contradicts itself, what each statement is and which one the estimate uses). enrollments (optional): the enrollments the entry applies to, all when absent. pipeline/build_data.py attaches each entry to data/benefits.json under benefits[year][plan_code]['known_gaps'] and checks that each quote occurs on the named brochure page (pipeline/raw/brochures_txt/<year>/<brochure>.txt, whitespace-insensitive). amounts: {self, self_plus_one, family} or null where the brochure gives no amounts by enrollment. text is the sentence shown to users in 'See the math', after 'Not included in this estimate:' for a cost term and on its own for a conflict.

gaps.text: a $500 calendar-year deductible that applies to inpatient and outpatient hospital services and MRI/CT scans. The brochure does not say whether it is per person or per family, so the estimate may be low by $500 for each person or each family.
gaps.quote: The calendar year deductible is $500, which applies to inpatient and outpatient hospital services
gaps.reason: OPM's spreadsheet and the app carry no deductible. The brochure (p25, p26) has a $500 deductible limited to hospital services and MRI/CT; it gives no amounts per enrollment type and does not say per person or per family. Not modeled.

gaps.text: a hospital facility deductible on inpatient and outpatient hospital charges: $250 for Self Only, $500 for Self Plus One and for Self and Family. The estimate may be low by up to that amount.
gaps.quote: separate in-network and out-of-network $250 inpatient and outpatient hospital facility deductible
gaps.reason: The app's deductible is $0 / $0 / $0. The brochure has a hospital-facility-only deductible, in-network and out-of-network. Not modeled.

gaps.text: a hospital facility deductible on inpatient and outpatient hospital charges: $250 for Self Only, $500 for Self Plus One and for Self and Family. The estimate may be low by up to that amount.
gaps.quote: an in-network $250 inpatient and outpatient hospital facility deductible
gaps.reason: The app's deductible is $0 / $0 / $0. The brochure has an in-network hospital-facility-only deductible. Not modeled.

gaps.text: a separate deductible for Tier 2-5 prescription drugs: $100 for Self Only, $200 for Self Plus One and for Self and Family. The estimate may be low by up to that amount.
gaps.quote: $100 deductible for Self and $200 for Self Plus One
gaps.reason: The app has no drug deductible for this plan. The brochure has one for Tier 2-5 drugs under Blue Value Plus. Not modeled.

gaps.text: The brochure gives the out-of-network Self Plus One deductible as $1,000 in Section 4 and $1,500 in Section 5. The app shows $1,500. Out-of-network deductibles are not part of the cost estimate.
gaps.quote: for your enrollment reach $1,000 under High and Standard Option
gaps.reason: Section 4 (p27) says $1,000 for Self Plus One; every Section 5 page (p35, p56, p65, p69, p72, p76, p81) says $1,500. The app keeps $1,500.

gaps.text: The brochure gives the out-of-network Self Plus One deductible as $1,000 in Section 4 and $1,500 in Section 5. The app shows $1,500. Out-of-network deductibles are not part of the cost estimate.
gaps.quote: for your enrollment reach $1,000 under High and Standard Option
gaps.reason: Same brochure and conflict as B41: Section 4 (p27) says $1,000, Section 5 (p35 and others) says $1,500. The app keeps $1,500.

gaps.text: The brochure contradicts itself about the Self Plus One and Self and Family deductible: it says the deductible is $2,000 per person, met for the family once two members each meet theirs (pages 25 and 102), but also that one or more family members can meet the $4,000 family deductible (page 104); the estimate uses the shared $4,000 deductible, so it may be too high by up to $2,000.
gaps.quote: The deductible is $2,000 per person ($4,000 per Self Plus One enrollment
gaps.reason: TakeCare HDHP. Section 4 (p25) and Section 5 (p102, p171) say the Self and Family deductible is met when at least two covered family members have met their individual deductible; p104 and the other Section 5 subsections (p117, p126, p129, p132, p135) say it can be satisfied by one or more family members. The brochure states no individual threshold for one person. The app keeps the shared $4,000 deductible (aggregate).

gaps.text: The brochure contradicts itself about the Self Plus One and Self and Family deductible: Sections 4 and 5 give it as $3,500 per family unit, but the Summary (page 172) gives $1,650 per person, and a line later $1,750 per person, up to $3,500 for the family; the estimate uses the shared $3,500 deductible, so for one person it may be too high by up to $1,850.
gaps.quote: Self Plus One or Self and Family enrollment is $3,500 per family unit
gaps.reason: Kaiser Permanente Washington Options Federal HDHP. Section 4 (p26), the changes page (p18) and Section 5 (p100, p101, p117 and others) say $3,500 per family unit. The Summary (p172) says "$1,650 per person for Self Plus One or Self and Family enrollment" not to exceed $3,500, and one line later "$1,750 per person Self Plus One or Self and Family". The app keeps the shared $3,500 deductible (aggregate).
